company.name: Tasker
company.shortDescription: Tasker is the first AI-driven on-demand talent platform for hardware engineering tasks (remote or on-site) with output-based pricing.
company.description:
Tasker is the first on-demand talent platform for tech hardware companies to buy engineering tasks  that we guarantee to deliver on time, on budget and on quality. Task to output made easy!

Our unique solution helps tech hardware companies to solve problems that require hardware engineering skills and experience they don’t have in-house. Not only do we match the task with the best qualified and available engineer(s), you also pay for the result - not the hours. Tasker takes ownership of the task, contract and payments. 

At the same time, Tasker provides engineers the opportunity to future-proof their skills by getting access to the best flexible work opportunities and an active global community. The Tasker mobile app (Tasker for Engineers) is available for iPhone and Android devices and allows engineers to manage and respond to tasks on the go.
